title: Тонкости времён: Present Simple в рассказе, Present Perfect в новостях, Past для вежливости

why: Времена в английском не всегда показывают реальное время. Present Simple может оживить рассказ о прошлом, Present Perfect открывает новость, а Past Simple делает просьбу мягче и вежливее. В русском похожие приёмы есть («Иду я вчера по улице, и вдруг...»), но в английском они строго закреплены за жанрами.
formation: • Историческое настоящее: Present Simple вместо Past Simple для событий в рассказе: He opens the door and sees her.
• Новости: первая фраза в Present Perfect (или Present Simple в заголовке), подробности дальше в Past Simple: Police have arrested a man. He was caught at 6 a.m.
• Вежливость: Past Simple или Past Continuous вместо Present: I wanted to ask..., I was wondering if you could..., I was hoping you could...
usage: 1. Анекдоты и устные истории (historical present): A man walks into a bar and orders a coffee. (Заходит мужик в бар и заказывает кофе.) So I open the door, and there's a huge dog! (Открываю дверь, а там огромная собака!)
2. Пересказ сюжета фильма, книги, а также исторические описания для драматизма: Napoleon crosses the Alps and invades Italy.

3. Новости: сообщаем главное через связь с настоящим, детали уже в прошлом. Scientists have discovered a new planet. The discovery was announced yesterday. (Учёные открыли новую планету. О находке объявили вчера.) Как только появляется точное время (yesterday, at 9 a.m.), переходим на Past Simple.
4. Заголовки: Present Simple вместо прошедшего: Government cuts taxes. (Правительство снижает налоги.)

5. Вежливость, отстранение: Did you want anything else? (Вам ещё что-нибудь?) I was wondering if you could help me. (Не могли бы вы мне помочь?) I thought you might like some tea. Past «отодвигает» просьбу от настоящего и делает её менее давящей.
6. Глаголы-сообщения в настоящем: I hear / I gather / I understand that she has resigned. (Слышал, что она уволилась.)
signalWords: Breaking news, just, so, then, suddenly, and then (в рассказе); I was wondering, I was hoping, I wondered if (в просьбах); yesterday, at 9 a.m., last week (переход в Past Simple в новости).
mistakes: ✗ Breaking news: a bridge collapsed in Texas. → ✓ a bridge has collapsed (свежая новость, связь с сейчас)
✗ The company has announced the merger yesterday. → ✓ announced (с yesterday только Past Simple)
✗ So I open the door and I saw a dog. → ✓ and I see a dog (не смешивайте времена в рассказе)
✗ I was wanting to ask... → ✓ I wanted to ask... (want — глагол состояния, Continuous не нужен)
✗ I wonder if you could help me, please? (слишком прямо в серьёзной просьбе) → ✓ I was wondering if you could help me.
remember: Время в английском — это ещё и жанр: рассказ в настоящем, новость через Perfect, вежливость через Past.

exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в Present Perfect или Past Simple (стиль новостей)

items.prompt: News: Scientists ___ (discover) a new planet.
items.answer: have discovered

items.prompt: News: The company ___ (launch) a new app.
items.answer: has launched

items.prompt: The announcement ___ (be) made at 9 a.m. yesterday.
items.answer: was

items.prompt: The president arrived in Paris this morning. He ___ (meet) the prime minister at noon.
items.answer: met

items.prompt: Breaking news: Two people ___ (die) in a crash on Highway 5.
items.answer: have died

items.prompt: Police say the driver ___ (lose) control of the car.
items.answer: lost

items.prompt: The government ___ (cut) taxes again. The decision was announced yesterday.
items.answer: has cut

items.prompt: Workers ___ (return) to work on Monday after a two-week strike.
items.answer: returned

exercises.instruction: Перепишите историю в историческом настоящем (Present Simple)

items.prompt: A man walked into a bar and asked for a drink.
items.answer: A man walks into a bar and asks for a drink.

items.prompt: So I opened the door and saw a huge dog.
items.answer: So I open the door and see a huge dog.

items.prompt: Then she looked at me and said nothing.
items.answer: Then she looks at me and says nothing.

items.prompt: He picked up the phone and called his boss.
items.answer: He picks up the phone and calls his boss.

items.prompt: Suddenly the lights went out.
items.answer: Suddenly the lights go out.

items.prompt: Napoleon crossed the Alps and invaded Italy.
items.answer: Napoleon crosses the Alps and invades Italy.

items.prompt: The hero found the map and ran out of the house.
items.answer: The hero finds the map and runs out of the house.

items.prompt: Then the dog jumped over the fence and disappeared.
items.answer: Then the dog jumps over the fence and disappears.

exercises.instruction: Сделайте просьбу более вежливой с помощью прошедшего времени

items.prompt: I want to ask you something.
items.answer: I wanted to ask you something.

items.prompt: Do you want anything else?
items.answer: Did you want anything else?

items.prompt: I wonder if you can help me.
items.answer: I was wondering if you could help me.

items.prompt: I hope you can come to the party.
items.answer: I was hoping you could come to the party.

items.prompt: Can I borrow your charger? (start with Could)
items.answer: Could I borrow your charger?

items.prompt: I'm wondering if I can use your phone.
items.answer: I was wondering if I could use your phone.

items.prompt: Will you have a minute? (start with Would)
items.answer: Would you have a minute?

items.prompt: I'm hoping to speak to Ms. Lee.
items.answer: I was hoping to speak to Ms. Lee.

exercises.instruction: Найдите ошибку во времени и исправьте предложение

items.prompt: Breaking news: a bridge collapsed in Texas.
items.answer: Breaking news: a bridge has collapsed in Texas.

items.prompt: The company has announced the merger yesterday.
items.answer: The company announced the merger yesterday.

items.prompt: So I open the door, and I saw a huge dog.
items.answer: So I open the door, and I see a huge dog.

items.prompt: Researchers have published the results in March.
items.answer: Researchers published the results in March.

items.prompt: Prices have risen sharply, officials said. The increase has begun in May.
items.answer: Prices have risen sharply, officials said. The increase began in May.

items.prompt: I was wanting to ask about the price.
items.answer: I wanted to ask about the price.

items.prompt: A man walks into a bar. The barman asked him what he wanted.
items.answer: A man walks into a bar. The barman asks him what he wants.

items.prompt: Have you seen the news? A storm has hit the coast last night.
items.answer: Have you seen the news? A storm hit the coast last night.

items.prompt: Правительство объявило о новых налогах.
items.answer: The government has announced new taxes.

items.prompt: Объявление было сделано вчера вечером.
items.answer: The announcement was made last night. / The announcement was made yesterday evening.

items.prompt: Я хотел спросить, не могли бы вы мне помочь (очень вежливо).
items.answer: I was wondering if you could help me. / I wanted to ask if you could help me.

items.prompt: Заходит мужик в бар и заказывает кофе.
items.answer: A man walks into a bar and orders a coffee. / A man walks into a bar and orders coffee.

items.prompt: Я надеялся, что вы сможете прийти на встречу.
items.answer: I was hoping you could come to the meeting. / I was hoping that you could come to the meeting.

items.prompt: Компания только что выпустила новую версию приложения.
items.answer: The company has just released a new version of the app. / The company has just launched a new version of the app.

items.prompt: И тут она открывает дверь и видит его (в рассказе).
items.answer: And then she opens the door and sees him.

items.prompt: Землетрясение произошло в 5 утра, пострадали десять человек.
items.answer: The earthquake happened at 5 a.m., and ten people were injured. / The earthquake struck at 5 a.m., injuring ten people.
